# Genuine Blender blenloader_core sources

Pinned revision: https://github.com/blender/blender/commit/fbe82a46101643c5cf8d7ab331d6a47566008fa7

The upstream files under upstream/ are byte-for-byte identical to Blender's GPL-2.0-or-later sources. The Android FileReader port and build integration will live in native/. These are header and BHead reader components only, not the full Blender scene loader, depsgraph or renderers.

GPL-2.0 license text: ../blender_half/LICENSE-GPL-2.0.txt
